title: Pricing a Tutoring Agent: API vs Local GPU
description: This example compares the monthly cost of a hosted API against a 24/7 local GPU for a hypothetical tutoring agent at 200 queries per day.

steps.description: We define the workload: 200 queries per day, each with 300 system prompt tokens, 100 question tokens, and 250 answer tokens.
Hosted API prices: $15 per million input tokens, $60 per million output tokens (GPT-4 class rates).
Cost per query adds input and output costs: 400 input tokens at $15/M and 250 output tokens at $60/M gives the per-query cost.

steps.question: Which monthly cost is higher: the API cost or the 24/7 GPU cost?
steps.answer: The monthly local GPU cost ($360) is higher than the monthly API cost ($126).

steps.description: Monthly local GPU cost prints: $360.00 (GPU runs 24/7 at $0.50/hour regardless of query volume).
